sentences.text: Vagaceratops is a genus of chasmosaurine ceratopsid dinosaur that lived during the Late Cretaceous period in what is now Alberta.
This animal was a medium-sized ceratopsian reaching 4.5 meters in length and weighing 1.2 metric tons.
The genus is known primarily from three fossil skulls.
Fossils of Vagaceratops have been recovered from the Upper Dinosaur Park Formation in the Canadian province of Alberta.
Vagaceratops is classified in the family Ceratopsidae and the subfamily Chasmosaurinae.
Vagaceratops lived during the Campanian stage, from 83.6 to 72.2 million years ago.
The relationships of Vagaceratops remain debated, with it having been allied variously with Kosmoceratops or Chasmosaurus.
